srList.sentence: Study 1: BFI and SAF fatigue comparison sample To validate the harmonized SAF fatigue item within the MPN-10, data were used from a randomized survey deployed in 2017 designed to test measure equivalence, validity, and reliability for the MFSAF v4.

sentenceParts.c: Study 1: BFI and SAF fatigue comparison sample To validate the harmonized SAF fatigue item within the MPN-10, data were used from a randomized survey deployed in 2017 designed to test measure equivalence, validity, and reliability for the MFSAF v4.

srList.sentence: Statistical analysis Within study 1, agreement between BFI and SAF fatigue scores, and twice administered SAF fatigue scores, were assessed using Pearson correlations (r) and Bland-Altman methods.

srList.sentence: MPN-10 TSS was computed using BFI and SAF fatigue items, separately, and Pearson correlation was computed between the TSS.

srList.sentence: Order effects were evaluated using paired t-tests.

srList.sentence: Within study 2, known-groups validity was evaluated by comparing SAF fatigue between patients with and without reported splenomegaly using a t-test [8].
